00044 DataRecorderUGenInternal::DataRecorderUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00045                                                    UGen const& trig, 
00046                                                    Text const& file, 
00047                                                    const bool _timeStamp) throw()
00048 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, input.getNumChannels()-1),
00049     fileWriter(file),
00050     lastTrig(0.f),
00051     timeStamp(_timeStamp)
00052 {
00053     inputs[Input] = input;
00054     inputs[Trig] = trig;
00055 }
00056 
00057 void DataRecorderUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00058 {
00059     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00060     const float *trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00061     
00062     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; i++)
00063     {
00064         float thisTrig = trigSamples[i];
00065         
00066         if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00067         {
00068             if(timeStamp == true)
00069             {
00070                 fileWriter.writeValue(blockID+i);
00071                 fileWriter.write(" ");
00072             }
00073                 
00074             for(int channel = 0; channel < inputs[Input].getNumChannels(); channel++)
00075             {
00076                 float *values = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00077                 float value = values[i];
00078                 fileWriter.writeValue(value);
00079                 fileWriter.write(" ");
00080             }
00081             
00082             fileWriter.write("\n");
00083         }
00084         
00085         lastTrig = thisTrig;
00086     }
00087     
00088     for(int channel = 0; channel < inputs[Input].getNumChannels(); channel++)
00089     {
00090         float *inputValues = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00091         float *outputValues = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00092         memcpy(outputValues, inputValues, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00093     }
00094 }
00095 
00096 DataRecorder::DataRecorder(UGen const& input, UGen const& trig, Text const& file, const bool timeStamp) throw()
00097 {
00098     DataRecorderUGenInternal *internal = new DataRecorderUGenInternal(input, trig.mix(), file, timeStamp);
00099     initInternal(input.getNumChannels());
00100     generateFromProxyOwner(internal);   
00101 }
